title: Interior-product and pull-back bound |γ(w, T·, …, T·)| ≤ √(k+1)·|w|·‖T‖^k·|γ| (fact (F8))
statement: Let m, m′, k ∈ ℕ, let γ be a (k+1)-covector on ℝ^{m′} (γ : Covector (Eucl m′) (k+1)), w ∈ ℝ^{m′}, T : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m′} a continuous linear map, a ∈ ℝ, and let β be a k-covector on ℝ^m with β(v) = a·γ(Fin.cons w (i ↦ T(v_i))) for every v : Fin k → ℝ^m. Then |β| ≤ |a|·√(k+1)·‖w‖·‖T‖^k·|γ|. Here |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm, the Euclidean norm of the coefficients α(e_{I(1)}, …, e_{I(n)}) over strictly increasing index tuples I (e = standard basis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun), ‖w‖ is the Euclidean norm and ‖T‖ the operator norm.
lean_statement: ∀ (m m' k : ℕ) (γ : Covector (Eucl m') (k + 1)) (w : Eucl m') (T : Eucl m →L[ℝ] Eucl m') (a : ℝ) (β : Covector (Eucl m) k), (∀ v : Fin k → Eucl m, β v = a * γ (Fin.cons w (fun i => T (v i)))) → covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ |a| * Real.sqrt ((k : ℝ) + 1) * ‖w‖ * ‖T‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm γ
